statement: At pinned SDL source revisions, the Switch 2 Pro is among Nintendo models for which SDL selects libusb, and its Switch 2 HIDAPI driver requires direct libusb access to interface 1 bulk IN and OUT endpoints found at runtime. It claims that interface for USB configuration while it reads subsequent input through the HIDAPI device; USB permission and driver-detachment behavior are host-dependent and unmeasured.

applicability.scope: SDL USB discovery and configuration transport
